/v1/responses.contract: compatible request/response shape and streaming events
/v1/responses.retention: bounded in-memory store; records are lost on server restart

/v1/responses/:response_id.contract: lookup of process-local stored response records
/v1/responses/:response_id.retention: not available after server restart or memory-store eviction

/v1/responses/:response_id/cancel.contract: preview lifecycle route for process-local response records
/v1/responses/:response_id/cancel.retention: does not provide durable active-response cancellation semantics

/v1/responses/:response_id/input_items.contract: input-item lookup for process-local stored response records
/v1/responses/:response_id/input_items.retention: not available after server restart or memory-store eviction

/v1/realtime.contract: OpenAI Realtime GA events over WebSocket: session, input audio buffer, conversation items, responses, transcription; no WebRTC, SIP or MCP
/v1/realtime.retention: the conversation lives as long as the socket

/v1/realtime/client_secrets.contract: ephemeral ek_ keys bound to a session config, admitting /v1/realtime only
/v1/realtime/client_secrets.retention: keys live in memory for at most two hours and are lost on server restart
